reason: A configuration-only dsh bundle that connects users to AI NetCafé's hosted MCP tools for document and table processing, SQL conversion, reachability checks, cross-session memory, and scheduled jobs.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 dsh 配置 AI NetCafé 远程 MCP 服务的插件包，提供文档与表格处理、SQL 转换、可达性监测、跨会话记忆和定时任务等工具。
summaries.en: A dsh configuration bundle that connects to AI NetCafé's hosted MCP service for document and table processing, SQL transpilation, reachability monitoring, cross-session memory, and scheduled tasks.

capabilities: Connects dsh to a remote MCP server over outbound HTTPS
Processes user-provided documents and prompts on the hosted service
Provides document extraction, table processing, SQL transpilation, and validation tools
Stores cross-session memory when explicitly requested
Creates scheduled hosted tasks and reachability monitoring with change notifications
May use an optional AllRouter authorization key or paid per-call payment
